desc: Prove that row-prefix and column-prefix conditions are equivalent to black cells being closed under moving upward or leftward.
Prove that feasibility fails exactly when a prescribed white cell is weakly northwest of a prescribed black cell.
Implement the row-sorted dominance sweep with correct equal-row handling and required stdin/stdout delimiters.
Verify edge cases including equal rows or columns, all-black/all-white inputs, and \(N=1\).
